0022600027.text: The Cleveland Cavaliers, 4-3 and fifth in the East, host the Philadelphia 76ers, who are 7-1 and first in the East, in an Emirates NBA Cup East Group B game. Cleveland is 3-1 at home and has lost its last game, while Philadelphia is 3-0 on the road and has won four straight. The Cavaliers will be without Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Peyton Watson (hamstring soreness), while the 76ers are missing Ariel Hukporti (Achilles surgery) and Dominick Barlow (back fracture), and Cleveland trails the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 114-106 loss in Philadelphia on October 22, though the Cavaliers won all four meetings in the 2025-26 season.
